title: Workspace, vendored core, and differential harness
constraints: Edit only the isolated candidate worktree; never edit /Users/jamie/Documents/Projects/active/mr-crabs.
Pure Rust shipped crates: no Zig build dependency, linked libghostty-vt, build.rs linker directive, wgpu, Sugarloaf, or copied GPL Zed terminal code/comments.
Pin upstream alacritty_terminal to commit 1b2b36a64e88068ad02c95fad00ee2fad31c00bf and preserve Apache-2.0 provenance and notices.
Use vte 0.15 as the byte parser.
Keep oracle integration dev-only and process-based; it must never be a normal or build dependency of mr-crabs-app.
Do not launch a GUI application.
Do not run formatting, linting, builds, or tests; the lead performs identical validation for all candidates.
Commit the completed candidate implementation once and report the commit SHA.

behavior: Construct a terminal with nonzero GridSize.
Feed arbitrary byte chunks while preserving parser state across calls.
Produce a deterministic normalized snapshot containing size, cursor, cells, styles, and terminal modes.
Feeding the same stream whole or at every possible split point produces the same normalized snapshot for every short corpus case.
Long corpus cases exercise deterministic seeded randomized chunk boundaries.

oracle_contract: mr-crabs-oracle is a CLI differential runner with a corpus subcommand compatible with: cargo run -p mr-crabs-oracle -- corpus verification/corpus (from rust/).
The runner compares normalized Rust snapshots with checked-in Ghostty oracle expectations and exits nonzero on any mismatch.
A separate explicit refresh path may execute an externally supplied Ghostty oracle executable/library path, but ordinary checks use immutable checked-in fixtures and require no Zig toolchain.

Initial ANSI/DEC corpus covers printable ASCII, CR/LF, SGR reset/colors/styles, cursor movement/positioning, erase line/display, save/restore cursor, insert/delete characters and lines, scrolling region, primary/alternate screen, tabs, DEC origin/wrap/cursor visibility modes, UTF-8 wide text, and split escape/UTF-8 boundaries.
workspace_contract: All seven crates are workspace members and cargo metadata resolves them.
Non-S1 crates remain minimal compilable libraries/binaries with no fake production behavior or TODO placeholders.
mr-crabs-app dependency graph contains no Zig/libghostty-vt dependency.
Workspace dependency versions are pinned or exact where reproducibility requires it; Cargo.lock is checked in.
acceptance: cargo tree -p mr-crabs-app contains no ghostty, zig, libghostty-vt, wgpu, or sugarloaf dependency
Every short corpus case passes at all byte split points and long cases pass seeded randomized chunkings
